sloka: त्यक्तां यज्ञायुधै: सर्वैरभिरूपैश्च याजकै: ।सुत्याकाले विनिर्वृत्ते वेदिं गतरवामिव ॥ २.११४.८॥
transliteration: tyaktāṁ yajñāyudhai: sarvairabhirūpaiśca yājakai: ।sutyākāle vinirvṛtte vediṁ gataravāmiva ॥ 2.114.8॥

translations.english: It was like a sacrificial altar deserted by all its appliances and learned priests, fallen silent once the time of the Soma extraction had ended.
